title: Repairing a reversible coat

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The right pocket on my reversible coat has torn along the edge. I wear the dark side out on weekdays and the other side out on weekends. Can the pocket still open on both sides when you repair it?
turns.zh: 我的雙面大衣右邊口袋邊緣裂開了。平日我讓深色那面朝外，週末則讓另一面朝外。修補後，不管哪一面朝外，口袋都還能打開嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, if I repair the edge rather than cover the opening with a patch. It takes a little longer, but the pocket will work either way you wear it.
turns.zh: 可以，只要我修補邊緣，而不是用補丁蓋住開口。時間會長一些，但不論哪一面朝外，口袋都能使用。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That’s what I need. Could I pick it up Thursday morning? I need it for the evening.
turns.zh: 這就是我要的。我可以星期四早上來拿嗎？晚上會用到。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can have it ready by noon Thursday. The shop closes at five, so you can collect it in the afternoon. Bring your receipt, not the old patch you showed me.
turns.zh: 星期四中午前可以修好。店裡五點關門，你下午可以來領。帶收據就好，不用帶剛才給我看的舊補丁。
